name: scene-masknet-c
purpose: fine mask net c of the scene upmix renderer (hook/audio/scene_mask.c): per-bin posteriors vocals / drum_core / bass / other on the 257-bin grid once per 512 input frames; eligibility = other, protect = vocals + drum_core + bass; also steers the LFE V2 assist (bass, drum_core)
format: SMSKNET1: 8-byte magic, u32 ch=24 / hidden=12 / n_out=4, then 8131 little-endian float32 in struct scene_mask_weights order (hook/audio/scene_mask.h); the hook reads the file straight into the struct, exact size required
architecture: conv2048 (mask_net.py ConvNet): 2048-point Hann analysis, 4 features per bin, conv1 k8/s4 (1025 -> 257) -> two conv k5 with residuals -> per-bin GRU(12) -> linear head to 4 sigmoid posteriors; 8.1 k parameters, ~2.0 M MAC per control (192 M MAC/s)
training: docs/audio/UPMIX_SCENE_ALGORITHM_2026-10-08.md section 16: fine net c, ctx 24 / hidden 12, 6000 steps, MoisesDB; training PC run masknet-fine2048-c/a (scene_mask_fixtures.py docstring); feat_mean/feat_std standardisation from the checkpoint, no calibration (calib nan -> has_calib 0)
export: tools/stereo-upmix-render/port/export_masknet_weights.py masknet_oracle.npz scene_masknet_c.bin (2026-10-09); masknet_oracle.npz = scene_mask_fixtures.py goldens (weights + 3750 controls of the oracle source), the npz records no run name
verified: hook runtime (NEON, rational tanh/sigmoid, exponent-bit log) vs torch on the C features 4.2e-4 (gate 1e-3); end to end vs the stored goldens 5.2e-3 posteriors / 4.1e-3 elig+protect (gate 1e-2; the reference's own float32 noise is 4.2e-3); port/test_mask.py and port/test_hook_render.py (-71.7 dB on the net's own rows)
on_unit: /mnt/app/root/hooks/scene_masknet_c.bin, read once at audio init only with AUDIO_SCENE=1 and AUDIO_SCENE_MASK_BLOB set (both commented out in deploy/smartphone_integrator/carplay_startup.sh)
cost_on_the_unit: 1.37 M ARMv7 instructions per 512-frame control on the QEMU bench (scene_mask_bench, -O2 1,368,181 / -O3 -fno-math-errno 1,375,745; was 19.4 M before the NEON port of 2026-10-09), run on the scene mask worker thread by default (AUDIO_SCENE_MASK_SYNC=0): the audio thread pays ~1 k instructions per period for the hand-off and the rows apply one control (10.7 ms) late; see docs/build-and-deploy/SCENE_BACKEND_DEPLOY.md
